title.en: Fable 9 — The Peacock and the Crane

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: The peacock showed off his feathers.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר לעגור: אתה אפור ופשוט.
sentences.en: He said to the crane: you are grey and plain.
The crane did not get angry and did not answer.
He opened his wings and flew up high.
The peacock stayed on the ground.

sentences.ar: נוצות יפות בלי כוח לא מרימות אותך.
sentences.en: Beautiful feathers without strength do not lift you.
